facts.text: Under Doane's Four-Year Graduation Guarantee, Doane pays the tuition cost of any remaining classes if a student does not finish in four years.

sources.title: Graduate in Four Years Guaranteed | Doane University in Omaha NE
sources.quote: We clearly outline what we will do and what we expect from you, if you don't complete your degree in four years, Doane will pay the cost of your remaining classes.
